newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul wins Cummins pump contract.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul wins Cummins pump contract.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp. said Monday it will supply electric diesel fuel priming pumps to Cummins Engine Co Inc beginning in 1998.
The electric diesel fuel priming pump will be used in the Signature 600 engine, produced by Cummins Heavy Duty Engine Group for the on-highway heavy truck market.
Production of the priming pumps begins April 1, 1998 at Federal-Mogul's Logansport, Ind., manufacturing plant.

"The priming pump is a brand new application for Federal-Mogul developed in our Logansport R&D Center to Cummins' specifications," said Steven Feeny, general manager of Federal-Mogul's general products operations. "This is our fourth electric fuel pump application at Cummins and our first project with the Heavy Duty Group."
